description: Persistent threaded-discussion container. Author renders <article data-comment> children with metadata; component decorates each with author header, relative timestamp, action row (Reply / Edit / Delete) + threaded indentation. Composes <comment-box> (reply form template) and bubbles <reaction-bar> events naturally. Bodies added through the API are text or sanitized HTML.

attributes.name: data-disabled
attributes.description: Read-only mode — no Reply / Edit / Delete actions

events.name: comment-thread:reply
events.description: Reply form submitted. Cancelable, same contract as comment-box:submit: do nothing and the form closes; waitUntil(promise) keeps it busy, closing on resolve and keeping the text on reject; preventDefault() during the handler keeps it open. Focus returns to the comment's Reply button when it closes.

events.name: comment-thread:edit-request
events.description: Edit clicked; value is the body's text. Author renders an editor and calls updateComment

events.name: comment-thread:delete-request
events.description: Delete clicked; author confirms + calls removeComment

methods.name: addComment(data)
methods.description: Insert a comment: data { id, author, time, bodyText? | bodyHtml?, parentId?, mine?, authorHref?, authorAvatar?, edited? }. bodyText is set as text; bodyHtml is sanitized. A reply goes after its parent's last descendant. Returns the <article>

methods.name: updateComment(id, patch)
methods.description: Patch a comment: patch { bodyText? | bodyHtml?, author?, edited? }

methods.name: removeComment(id)
methods.description: Remove a comment from the thread

childAttributes.name: data-comment
childAttributes.description: Marks an article as a thread comment

childAttributes.name: data-author-href
childAttributes.description: Optional link to the author's profile. Only http(s) and relative URLs become a link; anything else renders as text

childAttributes.name: data-time
childAttributes.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; rendered relative (Intl.RelativeTimeFormat in the element's lang) with the absolute time in title. Unparseable values render as-is

childAttributes.name: data-mine
childAttributes.description: Current user authored this comment — enables Edit / Delete

childAttributes.name: data-parent
childAttributes.description: Id of parent comment for nested replies

childAttributes.name: data-edited
childAttributes.description: ISO timestamp of last edit; renders "(edited)" badge

childAttributes.name: data-comment-body
childAttributes.description: Marks the comment body (any element, e.g. <section> or <div>)

childAttributes.name: data-reply-form
childAttributes.description: Marks the template whose content is cloned for the reply form

childAttributes.name: aria-labelledby
childAttributes.description: Set by the component: names each comment from its author and time
